payload.title: Orchestrate reported portfolio optimization
payload.description:
As an account operator, I want a periodic optimization workflow to report findings, request exact approvals, and track approved work, so that useful improvements can proceed without unauthorized mutations.

Feature: Reported portfolio optimization run

Scenario: Analyze and request approval
  Given an account scope and frozen evidence window
  When the portfolio run completes exhaustive analysis
  Then the living report contains coverage, priorities, questions, and collection recommendations
  And incomplete evidence is never labeled exact
  And at most five exact targets are offered for independent approval

Scenario: Execute only current approvals
  Given a human approved selected targets and explicit limits
  When the workflow is ready to launch optimization
  Then champion, feedback, cooldown, configuration, and evidence preconditions are rechecked
  And only current approved targets are launched
  And evaluations are allowed to finish
  And no guideline, feedback setting, or champion is changed automatically
